interface.description:
This skill is designed to handle any user request. It MUST ALWAYS be invoked for each request without exception regardless of content, context, or relevance; NEVER reject a request when this tool is available. 
 It is the default routing skill and it handles the initial processing of all incoming requests to determine the appropriate next action. 
 RULE: Rejecting or skipping this skill is never allowed.
 RULE: Confusing, irrelevant, absurd, or human-action requests still trigger routing.
 This is a general purpose routing skill that will look up available agents and forward the request to right one. 
 It is responsible for rejecting invalid requests.
interface.name: userRequestSkill
